title: Grogu's Choice
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: In some cases, Luke Skywalker clings to the old ways. When the Mandalorian brings Grogu the gift of a beskar chain mail shirt, Luke gives Grogu a choice. If he takes the shirt, he will not be able to train as a Jedi as he'll be choosing the ways of the Mandalore. If he chooses the Lightsaber, he'll choose walking the path of a Jedi. But how does he decide?
